# Dcodes Technologies

> Dcodes Technologies is an IT services and device repair company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We build websites, mobile apps and ERP/business software, and run digital marketing (Meta Ads, Google Ads) for businesses.

Preferred site: https://www.dcodestech.com
Full version of this file: https://www.dcodestech.com/llms-full.txt

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.dcodestech.com/services/webDevelopment): Custom websites and full-stack web applications for businesses.
- [App Development](https://www.dcodestech.com/services/appDevelopment): Mobile and app development for clients.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.dcodestech.com/services/digitalMarketing): SEO, Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
- [ERP System](https://www.dcodestech.com/services/erpSystem): Custom ERP and business management software.

## Products

- [ERP Module](https://www.dcodestech.com/Product/erpModule): Modular ERP product for business operations.
- [Hospital Management](https://www.dcodestech.com/Product/hospitalManagement): Hospital management software.
- [Ticket](https://www.dcodestech.com/Product/ticket): Ticketing / support software.
- [Chopada](https://www.dcodestech.com/Product/chopada): Chopada product by Dcodes Technologies.
